import {usePlugin} from '@conciv/plugin/experimental'
import {Acme} from './rpc.js'

export function AcmeView() {
  const ctx = usePlugin()
  const rpc = ctx.client.rpc(Acme)
  const search = rpc.search
  const {save, reset: clear} = ctx.client.rpc(Acme)
  void search({query: 'a'})
  void save({id: 'a'})
  void clear({})
  return <p>aliased</p>
}
